chapter: Childhood, first drums and the hustling years
title: Stranded in Pueblo with Belton Everett's band
summary: He worked with Pueblo musicians led by Belton Everett and was looked after by an aunt who worked for a country club.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yeah, this was -- no, I would say this would -- say about 1930, '31, and it was really rough, really rough. So then, I met some musicians from Pueblo, Colorado, and so they formed a little band, so I worked with them for awhile. A fellow by the name of Belton Everett. And I worked with him, because there was another saxophone player in the town, so they took the rhythm section and some others, and we worked with them around Pueblo and all of that. And he gave us a place to say and things like that.
